result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall (header, search, promo banner, carousels, and cards are well aligned). One clear defect was found: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the screen being shown.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows 'Profile' as the active/selected tab (green icon and label) while the content displayed is the Home feed (delivery address, search, promo banner, restaurant carousels). The 'Home' tab is rendered in the inactive gray state, so the navigation state does not match the visible screen.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab indicator to the current route so that 'Home' is highlighted when the home feed is displayed, and 'Profile' only when the profile screen is shown.
